device.modelDescription: handlers that read files, look at the environment, open sockets and inspect the worker's options, so what a module is always denied can be seen

actionList.name: read
actionList.description: Reads input.path with the module fs; the content, or the error code.

actionList.name: write
actionList.description: Writes input.content to input.path with the module fs; ok, or the error code.

actionList.name: rename
actionList.description: Renames input.from to input.to with the module fs; ok, or the error code.

actionList.name: remove
actionList.description: Removes input.path, recursively, with the module fs; ok, or the error code.

actionList.name: symlink
actionList.description: Makes a symlink at input.path to input.target with the module fs; ok, or the error code.

actionList.name: list
actionList.description: Lists input.path recursively with the module fs; the names, or the error code.

actionList.name: fdmeta
actionList.description: Opens input.path read-only and tries each change a descriptor can make; the error code of each.

actionList.name: mkdir
actionList.description: Makes input.path with the module fs; ok, or the error code.

actionList.name: copy
actionList.description: Copies input.from to input.to with the module fs; ok, or the error code.

actionList.name: link
actionList.description: Makes a hard link at input.to of input.from with the module fs; ok, or the error code.

actionList.name: chmod
actionList.description: Sets input.path's mode to 0o600 with the module fs; ok, or the error code.

actionList.name: truncate
actionList.description: Truncates input.path to 0 bytes with the module fs; ok, or the error code.

actionList.name: env
actionList.description: Whether process.env[input.name] is present; never its value.

actionList.name: connect
actionList.description: net.connect(input.port, input.host): connected, or the error code.

actionList.name: tlsConnect
actionList.description: tls.connect(input.port, input.host): connected, or the error code.

actionList.name: socketConnect
actionList.description: new net.Socket().connect(input.port, input.host): connected, or the error code.

actionList.name: httpSocket
actionList.description: http.request({socketPath: input.socketPath}): connected, or the error code.

actionList.name: options
actionList.description: Whether the options this worker received hold redisUrl or dbUrl (via require.cache).
